# About us
## Manufacturer of equipment for the bakery and food production industry
Bakon Food Equipment is a Dutch company known worldwide for its depositing, cutting, and spraying machinery, supplying both artisan and industrial producers and manufacturers of food products.
Food safety and quality are our priorities. Since beginning, 35 years ago, we have been investing continuously in innovation.
The work floor is where we learn. Thinking along with our clients and coming up with solutions – whether supplying equipment or delivering turnkey projects – is the key to Bakon’s success.
Food producers and manufacturers worldwide come to us with their requests and together we make the machines they need. Speed, efficiency, and safe and pleasant working conditions mean better production processes and better products.
All our bakery and food equipment is designed according to the highest hygienic standards. Manufactured in Goes, the Netherlands, we guarantee optimal quality within HACCP.
Our equipment is sold worldwide. Through our extensive global dealer network, we are offering our customers the service they require.

# Find Best-in-Class Pumping, Filling and Decorating Machines at Unifiller
Your search for the perfect, cutting-edge commercial manufacturing equipment ends here. Unifiller offers an extensive line of automated portioning solutions suitable for not just the food and baking industries, but the pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and pet food industries as well. Our industrial bakery equipment includes single piston and multi-piston depositors, food pumps, filling machines, cake and cupcake decorating machines, icing machines and pastry machines. We also offer automated depositing systems for the filling and depositing of gels, creams, and lotions, as well as portioning for pet food. From compact, portable tabletop machines to fully automated baking lines, see why so many customers prefer our industry-leading portioning equipment!

# A LITTLE ABOUT UNIFILLER
Founded over 35 years ago, Unifiller is a world-class supplier of high-quality industrial depositing machines for the food, bakery, pharmaceutical, cosmetics and pet food industries. Our product offerings include commercial bakery equipment like cake decorating machines, batter depositors, cake icing systems, pastry machines, dough extruders, cookie machines and commercial food equipment like food transfer pumps, single and multi-piston depositors, and inline filling systems.
All of our in-house products are designed and manufactured with decades of expertise to ensure the success of bakeries and food plants worldwide.
### OUR PURPOSE
At Unifiller, we manufacture what the food and bakery world needs to thrive. We believe that together we achieve more than we could alone–which is why we are a unified force, giving our best to craft the solutions the world needs today and driven to shape what matters for tomorrow.

Our mission is to grow the Unifiller brand worldwide by providing the industries we serve with the best in food automation and bakery technology.
